decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The London Borough of Hounslow as the Local Planning Authority hereby certifies that on 1 November 2005, the erection of roof dormer extension (3.902m wide X 3.7m deep X 1.6m high with a volume of 11.5m3), raising part of the existing single storey side extension (1.1m wide X 2.44m deep by 0.22m high with a volume of 0.59m3), installation of roof lights (with a volume of 1.11m3) and a reduction in the height of the roof of the existing single storey rear extension (reducing volume by 4.16m3), as shown on drawing number 472/2A dated 8 September 2005 and received on 13 September 2005, was lawful within the meaning of Section 191 and 192 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 for the following reason:
Following the proposed extensions consisting of a roof dormer extension, raising part of the existing single storey side extension, installation of roof lights and a reduction in the height of the roof of the existing single storey rear extension, the resulting building would fall within the provisions of Schedule 2, Part 1,Class A, Class B and Class C, of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995.
description: Certificate of lawfulness for the erection of roof extension, raising part of single storey side extension and installation of roof light to rear extension to house.
